context: A uni student gives life advice to his teen friend
purpose: Teach: 望み/すこし/かぎり/幼い/ボケ/ゆとり/せいぜい/独り言

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、ちょっと聞いてください。最近、将来の望みが全然わからなくて…
lines.en: Senpai, listen for a sec. Lately I have no idea what my hopes for the future even are.
lines.style: Hesitant teen voice, slightly downcast, seeking advice from an older friend.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ああ、わかるよ。俺もすこし前まで同じ感じだったから。
lines.en: Ah, I get it. I felt the exact same way until a little while ago.
lines.style: Warm, casual uni-student tone, relaxed and reassuring throughout the reply.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも、先輩は幼い頃から夢があったでしょう?私にはそれがないんです。
lines.en: But senpai, you've had a dream since you were little, right? I don't have anything like that.
lines.style: Slightly envious, vulnerable teenage tone with a quiet sigh.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いや、俺の知るかぎり、十代で夢が決まってる奴なんてほぼいないって。
lines.en: Nah, as far as I know, almost no one in their teens has their dream figured out.
lines.style: Confident but gentle, friendly upperclassman energy with a small chuckle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 焦らずに、心のゆとりを持つのが一番大事だよ。
lines.en: Don't rush it — having some breathing room in your heart is what matters most.
lines.style: Soft, advisory tone, almost philosophical delivery for a uni student.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そうですか…つい家で独り言ばっかり呟いちゃって、自分でもボケたのかなって思います。
lines.en: Really… I keep muttering to myself at home, and I'm starting to wonder if I've gone a bit dotty.
lines.style: Self-deprecating, half-joking teen voice with a small embarrassed laugh.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ははっ、それは考えすぎだって。今はせいぜい好きなことを試してみればいいんだよ。
lines.en: Haha, you're overthinking it. For now, just go ahead and try whatever you like — that's plenty.
lines.style: Laughing, encouraging, big-brotherly delivery with warm reassuring energy.
